name: friday-01-radial-xai
description: Radial layout, sci-fi brutalist, xAI. Four reasons ringed around a central pager.

brief.topic: Why shipping to production on a Friday afternoon is a bad idea
brief.headline: NO DEPLOYS ON FRIDAYS
brief.subtitle: A FIELD GUIDE TO SURVIVING THE WEEKEND
brief.diagram: A pager at the center connects by leader lines to four labels: ROLLBACK, ONCALL, TRAFFIC and MEMORY

sections.heading: 01 - NOBODY TO ROLL BACK
lines: The person who wrote it is on a train
The person who reviewed it is at a wedding

sections.heading: 02 - THE PAGER IS THE PLAN
lines: Every unstaffed hour is a staffed hour later
Saturday 2am is not a deploy window

sections.heading: 03 - TRAFFIC LIES ON FRIDAY
lines: Weekend load looks nothing like Friday load
The bug waits politely until Monday

sections.heading: 04 - MONDAY YOU IS A STRANGER
lines: Two days erases why you touched that file
The commit message will not save you
